scope: Original cam1a locations and m01 to m02 continuity

anchors.label: base1ArtifactPos
anchors.note: The original first outpost has an artifact anchor, no factory.

oldOverlap.resolution: New games use the original northern headquarters. Old conquered plateau is inherited as neutralized; its missing technology remains collectable.

retained: Player base and economy, vehicles, health, resources, research, valid orders, captured wells, wrecks, personnel and kill totals. Old campaigns keep their saved geography.
adaptation: Positions and authored towers follow original cam1a. Existing game models, story IDs, support buildings and road connections are adapted; this is not a one-to-one asset or balance port.
limitation: The broad check-mission --full stops at the pre-existing Saved cliff pose receives a bounded exit route fixture. This failure was also reproduced with the old camp configuration and no new m01 layout. It is not counted as a passing full playthrough.
